item.title: BFI Top 20 Greatest Films of All Time
item.description:
The list can be found here. Top 20:

  • Seven Samurai - Akira Kurosawa
  • Apocalypse Now - Francis Ford Coppola
  • Persona - Ingmar Bergman
  • Close-up - Abbas Kiarostami
  • Meshes of the Afternoon - Maya Deren
  • The Searchers - John Ford
  • Cleo from 5 to 7 - Agnes Varda
  • La Regle du jeu - Jean Renoir
  • The Godfather - Francis Ford Coppola
  • Sunrise A Song of Two Humans - F.W. Murnau
  • Singin’ in the Rain - Gene Kelly
  • Man with a Movie Camera - Dziga Vertov
  • Mulholland Drive - David Lynch
  • Beau Travail - Claire Denis
  • 2001: A Space Odyssey - Stanley Kubrick
  • In the Mood for Love - Wong Kar Wai
  • Tokyo Story - Yasujiro Ozu
  • Citizen Kane - Orson Welles
  • Vertigo - Alfred Hitchcock
  • Jeanne Dielman, 23 Quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles - Chantal Akerman

What I’m doing now

Hello! My name is Dylan Clark and I’m currently a Senior DevOps Engineer from Scotland. I work at Smarter Grid Solutions with an incredible team of people to help customers manage their DER (distributed energy resources). I’m part of the DevOps team, where I focus on automating and optimizing our infrastructure and deployments.

Before joining the DevOps team, I worked as a Software Engineer at Smarter Grid Solutions. I was involved in the development of Java Springboot micro-services, as we transitioned our flagship product from a monolithic architecture to a microservices architecture.
